Overview:

From a problem worth solving to a startup worth investing in.

About the Opportunity

Udbhav'26 is a startup and innovation challenge organized by E-Cell, Computer Department, Pimpri Chinchwad College of Engineering & Research (PCCOER), designed to take participants from identifying a real-world problem to building a working MVP and pitching their solution.

UDBHAV'26 follows an Open Innovation approach, giving participants the freedom to choose a problem and develop a solution without predefined problem statements or fixed domains.

The challenge combines innovation, technology, entrepreneurship, problem-solving, and business thinking, giving participants an opportunity to turn their ideas into practical solutions.

Idea → Build → Pitch

The Udbhav'26 Journey

Round 1 — Idea + Build (Online)

Participants identify a real-world problem, develop a startup solution, submit their 7-slide Idea Deck, and demonstrate their MVP through a 2–3 minute video.

The strongest ideas and implementations will be shortlisted for the offline finale.

Round 2 — Shark Tank (Offline)

Shortlisted participants/teams will present their MVP and pitch their startup before a judging panel at PCCOER, Pune.

The finale will focus on MVP demonstration, pitching, business potential, and investor-style Q&A.

Why Participate?

  • Build — Turn your idea into a working MVP.
  • Innovate — Solve a real-world problem through Open Innovation.
  • Pitch — Experience a Shark Tank-style startup pitch.
  • Connect — Interact with fellow innovators, mentors, and judges.
  • Compete — Showcase your solution and compete for exciting prizes and recognition.

This competition is open exclusively to students currently enrolled in colleges located in Pune; participants from colleges outside Pune are not eligible to register.

Registration Fee & Payment Details

Registration Fee: ₹100 per team

UPI ID: 9172933274@ybl

Payment QR Code Link: https://iili.io/ndPpWu4.md.jpg

Note: While making the payment, please mention your team name and startup name in the format TeamName_StartupName. This helps us verify your registration quickly.

Whatsapp Group Link : https://chat.whatsapp.com/Cgsol0MbT687HH7TorGCLN

Udbhav'26 — Idea. Build. Pitch.

Find the problem. Build the solution. Pitch the future.

Note: Payment will not be refunded once done, the team cannot cancel their registrations in any condition.

Teams will not be provided with any accommodation for the final round event.
